about_the_game: Throne of Flags is a high-octane blend of strategy, FPS combat, and tactical alliances. Capture 3 enemy flags, forge and break pacts, raid with vehicles, and dominate the battlefield.
detailed_description: Throne of Flags is a high-octane blend of strategy, FPS combat, and tactical alliances. Capture 3 enemy flags, forge and break pacts, raid with vehicles, and dominate the battlefield.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+ compatible card (Intel HD or better)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 570
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
